dog.description_text:
Meet Dulce! Cute as a button, with big ears, a beautiful smile, and enough personality to fill a room, this mini pittie boy is ready to steal your heart! Dulce is energetic, happy-go-lucky, and the kind of buddy who can turn an ordinary day into an adventure. Whether you're looking for a companion for your outings or a little best friend to make you smile, Dulce is ready to bring the fun. He's got the looks, the charm, and the personality. All he's missing is YOU! Come meet Dulce and see why good things really do come in small packages. Adopt this adorable boy!

Every bio is just a snapshot of the animal. For more information about Dulce and to learn if he may be the right fit for your home, please reach out to our Adoptions Team.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in fostering or adopting? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
